data.body: CLOSED — landed as change https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1041 (merged commit 49849ef0e, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved). Delivered: det_gate_rules.py (DetGateRule frozen dataclass — text_all conjunction / file_impact_globs / file_impact_reason_re — plus _DET_OVERLAY_RULES with audit-verbatim T13/T14 pre-filters and _DET_LEAF_GATE_RULES for removal-rationale/asserted-capability; registry re-exports the seam), route_criteria gate_log + leaf-gate block with skips surfaced as coverage.routing.det_gated via the assemble step, ADR 0034 amendment note (pre-filter contract + zero-findings evidence), criteria_routing.json trigger annotations, and 72 unit tests in tests/unit/plan_review/test_det_criterion_gates.py (evasion-vocabulary fire cases, total-absence skips with zero LLM routing, conjunction negatives both ways, file_impact-only arms, T5a/T5d/T7/T12 behavior preservation, ADR assertion). Patchset 2 was a clean rebase onto main after the unrelated reuse-test breakage (bug 2c38, change 1044) was fixed. Note: registry.py sat at 744 LOC against the absolute 800 cap, so the verbatim trigger vocabularies live in the new det_gate_rules.py with registry re-exports — the routing seam (registry.overlay_triggers / _DET_OVERLAY_RULES / new leaf_gate_triggers / _DET_LEAF_GATE_RULES) is unchanged for callers.
